basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of Bernal Heights, 201-207 Richland Ave presents an opportunity to acquire  five-unit apartment building in San Francisco's highly desirable Bernal Heights neighborhood. The  multi-family property consists of four spacious one-bedroom units and one studio. Two units will be delivered vacant. The building also  features a two-car garage. The property is just steps from shops, cafes, and restaurants along Cortland Avenue. Commuters  will appreciate easy access to public transportation, major freeways, and tech shuttle stops. The strong rental demand in Bernal Heights, coupled with the potential for value-add improvements, makes this an attractive investment with long-term growth potential.
